description: Replace a post's whole video edit with a list shaped like edit_get's edit (anything left out takes its default), or copy another post's edit in the same workspace with from_post_id to make this one like it (clips keep that post's takes: swap them with edit_change swap_take). For small changes use edit_change. Pass base_rev (edit_get's rev) so an edit made on the phone meanwhile isn't lost; EDIT_CONFLICT means get the edit again and redo yours on it. The phone picks the new list up at its next sync and renders it there; nothing renders on the server. Undo with undo.

base_rev.description: The rev your list started from (edit_get's rev)

edit.description: The whole list, as edit_get returns it

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: edit_set
title: Replace a post's video edit
